title: On the Road
author: Jack Kerouac
summary: A young writer in post-war New York hits the road with his wild, magnetic friend. They crisscross America in borrowed cars and buses, chasing jazz, women and a feeling they cannot name.
readIf: you want a restless, breathless, jazz-inflected road novel that captures a particular era of youth.
skipIf: you want responsibility or plot, as the men use and discard many of those around them.

pairings.reason: A warmer, more tightly plotted road novel about a different group of young men in the same decade.
Another classic of a restless young narrator who rejects the settled life, with a more bitter voice.
Also follows a circle of drifting friends who drink their way across places in search of meaning.
